View gallery View gallery Experience the South Coast of Iceland on a full-day tour from Reykjavík , reaching the remarkable Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon and Diamond Beach . This 14-hour journey takes you across 380 km (236 miles) , showcasing some of Iceland’s most iconic landscapes shaped by glaciers, volcanoes and the ocean. What will you see on the Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon tour? Along the way, you will explore a range of natural highlights along Iceland’s coastline. Seljalandsfoss waterfall Stjórnarfoss waterfall Vík village Visit coastal landscapes where waterfalls, beaches and cliffs meet , including stops at lesser-known locations such as Stjórnarfoss waterfall . If you prefer a more intimate experience, you can also explore our South Coast small group tour . What is the Jokulsarlon Glacier Lagoon and Diamond Beach like? Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon is formed by an outlet glacier from Vatnajökull , Europe’s largest ice cap, creating a landscape of drifting icebergs. At nearby Diamond Beach, blocks of ice rest on black sand, forming a striking contrast between ice and volcanic shoreline. Created in the 1970s, this glacial lagoon has become a symbol of Iceland’s ever-changing nature , shaped by the forces of ice and time. This full-day tour combines glacier landscapes, coastal scenery and iconic landmarks, offering a comprehensive journey through South Iceland. A 30 minutes boat ride on the Glacier Lagoon can be purchased from your guide on the bus. Tickets cost ISK 7100 for 13+, ISK 3500 for kids aged 6-12, and free for kids 5 and under. Food and drinks are not included but can be purchased on the way, there is time allocated for lunch. We will also make a dinner stop, likely in Vík, on the way back to Reykjavík. The duration of the tour is 14 hours. Please be aware that the tour could run long if affected by bad weather or other delays. Cancellation policy: Cancellation fee of 100% if cancelled 1 day or less before departure. Got more questions or need help? No problem. Read FAQ or contact us on live chat or [email protected] Frequently Asked Questions How long is the driving time on this tour? The glacier lagoon day tour from Reykjavík lasts about 14 hours, making it one of the longest day tours in Iceland. The drive from Reykjavík to Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon is approximately 380 km each way, which takes around 5 hours under normal conditions. Including rest stops, sightseeing breaks, and the return journey, guests can expect a full-day experience with plenty of opportunities to stretch, explore, and enjoy the scenery along the way. Can I join an ice-caving or glacier-hiking tour from Jökulsárlón while on the Glacier Lagoon day tour? Unfortunately, it’s not possible to join a glacier tour from Jökulsárlón when you are taking the Glacier Lagoon day tour from Reykjavík. Glacier tours from Jökulsárlón typically take 3–4 hours, and because of the long driving distance back to the capital, there wouldn’t be enough time to complete the glacier activity and still make the return journey with the group. However, in winter, we recommend joining a 2-day South Iceland tour if you’d like to experience an ice cave adventure. On Day 2, you’ll have plenty of time for the glacier activity, as well as the opportunity to fully enjoy Jökulsárlón Glacier Lagoon and the Diamond Beach at a more relaxed pace. What about the meals on the glacier lagoon tour? We will have lunch and dinner stops along the way. Meals and drinks are not included on this tour. Is the tour itinerary subject to change? Your safety is our number one priority. With this in mind, BusTravel Iceland reserves the right to adjust the itinerary and/or take alternative routes depending on conditions.
